newsitem.title: USA: Business Resource sees Q3 loss.
newsitem.headline: Business Resource sees Q3 loss.

text.p: Business Resource Group Wednesday said it expects to post a third quarter quarter loss of about $1,000,000, or 20 cents per share, which includes restructuring and one-time charges of approximately $300,000, or $0.06 a share.
In a statement, the company said revenues for the fiscal quarter ending July 31, are expected to be approximately $12.7 million.
As the company has previously indicated, revenues from its largest customer, Cisco Systems, declined significantly in the third quarter to $1.5 million from $10.5 million in second quarter.

The company said its estimated backlog of orders at the end of the third quarter increased to $13 million, which represents an increase of $3.3 million, or 34 percent, over the backlog at the end of the second quarter.
The company also announced that it had taken steps to reduce operating expenses and to realign its management structure to better address the requirements of its business.
